sources.title: OpenThinker3‑7B Becomes a Top Open Reasoning AI Model
sources.snippet: OpenThinker3‑7B is a newly launched open-source language model designed for reasoning tasks. It's trained on high-quality public data and now ranks among the top-performing models in math, science, and code-based benchmarks. Built on Qwen2.5 architecture and trained on over 1.2 million carefully curated examples, OpenThinker3‑7B has become the go-to open-data model for structured reasoning.

sources.title: OpenThinker3 7B — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: OpenThinker3 7B is a reasoning-focused model that spends time working through problems step by step before arriving at answers. Built on Qwen2.5's architecture, it tends toward deliberate, extended thinking rather than quick responses — a trait that shows up clearly in logic and math tasks.
